rules.entry: LIMIT-TRIGGER (owner-approved 6:48 PM, live from C10): all signals captured to a watchlist (no liquidity/buys entry filter). Signal = 1h vol>=20k, 5m>+5%, 1h +10..80%, age<6h, mc<500k. Per coin: 5m-chart buy/sell momentum %, buying-zone low, paper limit trigger 1.5-6% below price. Paper-buy only after price dips to trigger then ticks up 1%+. Best score (1h% x buy%) fills free slots first. Watch expires 40 min.
rules.exit: Per coin: 1.5x take-profit for ALL open positions (owner 11:05 PM; was 3x) (entries from the 11 PM IST cycle on: 1.5x take-profit, owner voice note 10:45 PM relayed) (instant sell when price touches 1.5x), -50% stop loss, rug = liquidity < $5k (full loss), otherwise sell at market exactly 60 min after its own entry. Owner rules 12:32 PM + 4:26 PM, restored 7:57 PM.
rules.cooldown: 6h no re-entry on a coin that closed at or below 0.50x
